From: Ellie Grant <ellie.grant@sentrybridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SentryBridge SIG/CAIQ intake and kickoff request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on — SentryBridge is starting a SIG/CAIQ intake as part of our vendor assessment and we'd like to schedule a kickoff with Redwood's security/compliance team. Ideally the call covers: scope (which models and environment), evidence requirements for SIG/CAIQ, expected delivery milestones, and an overview of any shared responsibility considerations.

Attached is our in-progress question set (SentryBridge_SIG_Questions_v0.3.xlsx) — it's annotated with a few high-priority controls we need validated by 8/5. Our procurement counterpart (procurement@sentrybridge.com) will loop in contract questions, but for now this is strictly security intake.

Availability: are you free any time the week of 7/20? If you can propose 2 windows (preferred in the morning PST), we'll pick one.

Thanks,
Ellie Grant
Security Programs Lead
SentryBridge
[attachment: SentryBridge_SIG_Questions_v0.3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@sentrybridge.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SentryBridge SIG/CAIQ intake and kickoff request

Hi Ellie — great to meet you over email. We're available the week of 7/20 and can offer either:

- Tue 7/21, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Wed 7/22, 10:30–11:15 PT

Please pick one and I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. For the call we typically ask for the following up front to make the session productive:

1) A prioritized list of controls (you mentioned a subset needed by 8/5) — highlight 5 top controls if possible.
2) Any example evidence you prefer (e.g., specific syslog excerpts vs. screenshots).
3) Network scoping: are you assessing hosted API only or also Dedicated/Private deployments?

I'll prep an intake worksheet and invite Marcus Lin (logging/evidence owner) and Neha Kapoor (encryption & key management) from our team to the call.

Attached: Redwood_SIG_Shortlist.csv (helps map which Redwood artifacts map to common SIG questions).

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Head of Technical Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_SIG_Shortlist.csv (csv)]

Marcus / Neha — prepping for Tue 7/21 09:00 PT kickoff with SentryBridge (Ellie + Raj). Quick agenda & owners: 

- 09:00–09:10: Introductions + scope (I’ll lead)
- 09:10–09:25: Evidence mapping & examples (Marcus to review logging artifacts and retention docs)
- 09:25–09:35: Cryptography & key management (Neha to cover KMS/HSM integration notes and encryption-at-rest policy)
- 09:35–09:40: Next steps & timelines (I’ll capture action items)

Please review the short list I attached to Ellie and mark any controls where we need to generate new artifacts (e.g., sample syslog extracts, anonymized access logs, or configuration dumps). We should be ready to commit to delivery dates for items we own — Ellie flagged a small set they need by 8/5.

I'll share the intake worksheet during the call and record the meeting notes in the Drive folder.

-K

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: SentryBridge SIG intake — meeting notes & action items (follow-up)

Hi all — thanks for the kickoff today. Notes and agreed actions below (condensed):

Scope agreed:
- SentryBridge will assess Redwood hosted API plus one Dedicated instance (customer-managed VPC) used in their POC.
- Models in scope: "redwood-llama-v2-13b" (hosted) + dedicated-13b-q4f (dedicated).

Action items and owners (ASAP unless noted):
- RBW-1: Logging evidence — deliver anonymized access logs + example CloudTrail events (Marcus) — due 2026-07-30.
- RBW-2: Cryptography — provide KMS key policy, HSM integration diagram, and encryption-at-rest config (Neha) — due 2026-07-30.
- RBW-3: Data flow diagram & scope statement (Kimberly) — due 2026-07-23.
- RBW-4: Mapping doc linking SIG v2 questions to Redwood artifacts (Kimberly/Marcus) — due 2026-07-28.

Deliverables format guidance (SentryBridge preference):
- CSV or XLSX mappings for question-to-evidence.
- Timestamped log excerpts (anonymized) + short README describing collection method.
- Diagrams as PNG/PDF.

Evidence links and intake workspace: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSentryBridgeIntake
Jira tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-271

Attached: meeting notes PDF (kimberly_sentrybridge_meeting_notes_20260721.pdf).

Next sync: 2026-08-04 09:00 PT (30m) — tentative to review evidence collected.

Please hit reply to confirm owners and dates or flag conflicts.

Best,
Kimberly
